 Print The latest episode of Bigg Boss 20 saw many dramatic moments, a shocking eviction and more. The episode began with Salman Khan introducing some fun segments for the contestants. He also schooled the contestants for their behaviour on the show this week. One of the biggest highlights of the episode was Aman Gandhi’s eviction from the show. Salman Khan revealed that the three bottom contestants were Aman Gandhi, Uditi Singh and Mary Kom. While Uditi had her two lifelines, Aman and Mary had only one each. Later, Salman Khan confirmed that Aman Gandhi had been evicted from the reality show. As he exited the show, Arishfa Khan and Uditi Singh got very emotional. Arishfa said, “He understood me a lot. So many times, I’d say things to him in anger, but he would always understand me. Whenever I went wrong in the game, he came and told me.” Asif Khan and others calmed her down. The episode also saw many other dramatic moments, budding bonds and more. Fans on social media reacted to Aman’s eviction. While some thought it was fair, others mentioned how Aman deserved to stay in the game more than Mary Kom. A user wrote, “What a beautiful frame… Qazi grabbed and kissed Aman’s forehead with full haq.” Another user wrote, “I love that Uditi doesn’t sugarcoat anything about her own friends. I feel bad for Aman, but Uditi is right. Kash, Aman had taken a stronger stand. So, he wouldn’t have to go home today…” A user even said, “Although #AmanGandhi disappointed me in the last few days, this weekend was his strongest. He put his points across so well. Only if he had not been confused in his binds and had not been looking for validation. I didn’t expect it, but I am kind of feeling bad for him.” Get the latest TV News, TV Shows and more.
